purpose: Non-authoritative evidence bundle for an exact application release requesting Shine Defence review.

statuses.meaning: Evidence is ready for review; no badge claim is granted.
The candidate passed review and was promoted at that point in history. Accepted is a historical final outcome, not a claim that the release is still current.
A newer candidate replaced this candidate before review completed.
The candidate was closed without certification.

rules: A review candidate never grants or extends the Protected by Shine Defence badge.
At most one pending_review candidate may exist per app.
Every policy id must exist in the canonical Defence registry.
Accepted is an immutable historical review outcome; an app may accumulate multiple accepted candidates across successive reviewed releases.
Exactly one accepted candidate for a promotion-managed app must match the current canonical reviewed ledger and receipt; review-promotion-v1 verifies that current binding.
A pending candidate must differ from the app's currently reviewed release/profile identity.
Every accepted, superseded or dismissed candidate must have exactly one matching record in review-decisions-v1.
A pending_review candidate must not have a review decision record.
Superseded means replaced before review completed; a previously accepted candidate remains accepted when a later release is certified.
Superseded and dismissed candidates remain historical evidence rather than being deleted.
Evidence must contain bounded non-secret references; credentials, bearer tokens and private keys are forbidden.
nonClaims: Historical accepted status is not a current badge claim.
Build success alone is not a security review.
A dismissed or superseded candidate does not imply the release is unsafe.
